mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves several key steps. Look for a licensed and insured general contractor with a strong portfolio of whole-home remodels, particularly in your local area. Check references, read client testimonials, and review their communication style. Ensure they provide clear, detailed proposals that outline costs, timelines, and scope of work. A reputable contractor will also have experience navigating local permitting requirements and will offer a transparent process for managing your project from start to finish. Prioritize trust, experience, and clear communication.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor by verifying their license, insurance, and portfolio of whole-home remodels. Check references, review proposals, and ensure they communicate clearly and understand local permitting.
